civilopediaText.text: Southern Border clans swallow one another. The clan whose capital is the last one standing rules the mountains.

name: Endurance
milestones: Have highest score after max turns

civilopediaText.text: When time runs out, the strongest clan is the one remembered. The score counts what a clan has built and kept.
Eternal life, beyond any Venerable: raise a Venerable and have it seek Eternal Life (its Seek Eternal Life promotion) before its lifespan runs out.
